name: Ignition Vita
description: Unofficial PlayStation Vita port of Ignition (1997)
long_description:
Ignition (1997) is a PC arcade racing game. Ignition Vita lets you play the original Windows game on a PlayStation Vita.

It is not a rewrite or a remake. The port loads the original Ign_3dfx.exe (the 3dfx/Glide version of the game), runs its x86 code on the Vita through a dynamic recompiler (x86 → ARMv7), and provides, in native Vita code, everything the executable expects from Windows: files, timers, DirectInput, DirectSound, the Windows message loop, MCI CD audio and the Glide 3D API (translated to OpenGL calls on the Vita's GPU with vitaGL).
requirements:
- A PlayStation Vita (or PlayStation TV) with custom firmware allowing homebrew, with unsafe homebrew enabled (the port needs executable memory for its recompiler, so it is installed as an unsafe application).
- About 110 MB of free space for the game data (about 37 MB of data plus about 70 MB for the music if you provide it; the music size depends on how you encode it) and a couple of MB for the VPK.
